latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker — Create and Export AI Videos (v1.0.0)

- Initial release: Instantly turn raw footage or images into polished 1080p MP4 videos using AI, with no manual editing required.
- Direct cloud processing: Upload files, describe your desired outcome, and receive a finished download in 1–2 minutes.
- Automated setup: Seamless environment token creation and session management for quick start; notifies users when ready.
- Simple user workflow: Drag-and-drop uploads, natural language prompts for edits and exports, automated export/download.
- Cloud rendering pipeline: Supports a wide range of formats (mp4, mov, avi, etc.) and handles jobs on remote GPU nodes.
- Clear guidance and error handling for uploads, credits, and file issues.
